title: Certificate Renewal Failure Queue
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=certexpiry:check
| where status!="renewed"
| stats min(days_left) as days_left, latest(common_name) as common_name by endpoint
| where days_left<14
| sort days_left
description: Lists personal endpoints or services whose certificates are nearing expiry without a successful renewal.
value: Even for personal infrastructure, certificate expiry is a needless self-inflicted outage or trust warning.
implementation: Ingest certificate checks into `index=personal`; alert on endpoints inside the final two weeks without renewal.
visualization: Table of endpoints with common name and days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which of your personal sites or services are heading toward an expired certificate warning because renewal has not happened.
